name: Droost Views
description: Views tooling for AI agents: field-to-handler discovery, abstract reads of existing views, a gated declarative composer that turns an intent-level listing spec into validated view config, and a results-executor — exposed as MCP tools. Submodule of Droost.
project_description: Droost Views gives AI agents four MCP tools for working with Drupal Views. droost_views_handlers resolves every field of an entity bundle to its Views handler coordinates (storage table/column, filter/sort plugin ids, and the filter operators the composer supports). droost_views_get reads an existing view as an abstract model (per display, with default-display inheritance resolved: row rendering, style, pager, path, filters, sorts, and — for block displays — the Canvas component id it is placeable as; omit the view to list all views). droost_views_compose is a gated declarative composer that turns an intent-level listing spec (entity bundle, view mode rows, page and/or block display, grid/list style, sorts, exposed filters) into validated view config. droost_views_execute runs a view display with optional exposed-filter input and returns the real results (row count + first rows) — the verify half of compose. Only the composer changes state; it is gated by allow_config_write and CLI-only. Helper classes FilterShape and HandlerResolver back the field-to-handler mapping. It depends on the Droost base module and Views. This documents the 1.0.0-rc1 pre-release.
